Team —

We're 10 business days out from the QBR and I want to ensure the leadership packet includes both an OKR gap map and account-level annotated summaries that tie into our pipeline forecast. The ask is light but specific:

- By EOD today, please upload a single one-pager per strategic account (top 12 by ARR) into the Drive folder below. One-pagers should include: current weighted forecast, most-likely close month, top risks (1-2 lines), and the primary action we need from leadership.
- Karthik: consolidate the revised forecast numbers into the attached CSV schema (I put a template in Drive). Add a confidence band column (High/Med/Low).
- Tessa: highlight any account(s) with OKR alignment issues (customers tied to OKR-incented discounts, long lead times, or contractual SLO asks).
- Rishi: we need a short slide with consolidated runway + delta vs. last quarter for the exec deck. One slide, two charts.

Attachments: slides_qbr_prep.pptx (starter deck), okrs_gap_map.pdf (current OKR gaps), forecast_consolidation_20261128.csv (template)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBzQBR-prep-annotated
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8342

Tone: concise, evidence-backed, avoid long narratives — bullets and one action ask per account. We will review in the 4pm sync.

Thanks — Priyom

--
Priyom Das
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Priyom / Karthik —

Uploaded a quick OKR gap summary and flagged three accounts where product/engineering involvement is required before QBR:

1) Stratus AI — SLA clarification needed (they expect <50ms inference in dedicated mode for pilot). Product needs to sign off on feasibility; blocked until we confirm staging tests.
2) Nimbus Health — procurement requested data retention guarantees that map to Private deployment options. Security team already engaged but we need a one-liner for leadership outlining timeline (2–3 weeks).
3) Arcadia Retail — negotiation on discount ladder tied to OKR incentives (their Q1 targets). Sales and Finance alignment required.

I've added these as red flags in okrs_gap_map.pdf (page 2). For the one-pagers I kept asks to one sentence and included the stakeholder (e.g., "Action: Product validate latency floor — John A.").

Will be at the 4pm sync. If we need to pull in Product or Security directly, I recommend looping them into the exec call rather than extending the deck.

Thanks — Tessa
